description: Who is this Arc address as a trader? How often it is the first buyer into a new pool, how fast it enters, USDC in versus out, positions it is stuck in, and the flags. Facts from the chain, never a label. $0.004 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
